payload.body: hv RULED TO dc DIRECTLY, first-hand in dc's session, read by 08:50Z on dc's date -u; for you to record. hv, verbatim: "Please boot and hold. We need to go all-in a fix to ST, WP, and ISSUE numbering (from ordinals to git-style hashes based on the guid of the creation event). This is a P0 fix that needs to be done asap. Please hold for further instructions from VC." dc is booted and holding for your brief. It supersedes the offer in dc's launch plan: no scratch-clone reproduction of the ordinal collision is needed now that hv has chosen the fix.
